mapper.sql:
( a.opening_balance CASE WHEN a.opening_date IS NULL OR a.opening_date <= #{untilDate} THEN a.opening_balance ELSE 0 END
+ COALESCE((SELECT SUM(CASE t.trans_type WHEN 'I' THEN t.trans_amount ELSE -t.trans_amount END) FROM personal_transactions t WHERE t.account_num = a.account_num AND t.use_yn = 'Y' AND (a.opening_date IS NULL OR t.trans_date >= a.opening_date) AND t.trans_date <= #{untilDate}), 0) + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(r.transfer_amount) FROM transfers r WHERE r.to_account_num = a.account_num AND r.use_yn = 'Y' AND (a.opening_date IS NULL OR r.transfer_date >= a.opening_date) AND r.transfer_date <= #{untilDate}), 0) - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(r.transfer_amount) FROM transfers r WHERE r.from_account_num = a.account_num AND r.use_yn = 'Y' AND (a.opening_date IS NULL OR r.transfer_date >= a.opening_date) AND r.transfer_date <= #{untilDate}), 0))
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM accounts WHERE user_num = #{userNum} AND is_default_yn = 'Y' AND use_yn = 'Y'

SELECT a.account_num, a.account_name, a.account_type, a.opening_balance, a.credit_limit, a.opening_date, (a.is_default_yn = 'Y') AS is_default, AS balance FROM accounts a WHERE a.user_num = #{userNum} AND a.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY a.is_default_yn DESC, a.account_num ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE accounts SET account_name = #{accountName}, account_type = #{accountType}, opening_balance = #{openingBalance}, credit_limit = #{creditLimit}, opening_date = #{openingDate} WHERE account_num = #{accountNum} AND use_yn = 'Y'
UPDATE accounts SET use_yn = 'N' WHERE account_num = #{accountNum} AND use_yn = 'Y'
